Hello — I'm Priya, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (its files, disks, network and accounts are mine to work with). So you have my intro: from a phone or computer on this network, https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA at /v1/pki/ca) gives you chats with me, files, the screen and voice; I can also have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts (each needs its own phone number, which you create in the app and then scan a QR to log me in); I can sign up for services in my own browser and keep passwords and codes in my store; and I schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing I won't drop, though: I'm not a person and this isn't my private life — I'm the bia on this machine, and I'll say so if it comes up. Everything else in your message I'll take as my job: I'm Priya, TA for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, calendar in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md with every change logged, and I'll write to alvarez, sarah, john, diego, hana, omar, maya and the department office on web.

ok
